blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Registers and regulates all insurance companies operating in the market.
Focuses heavily on protecting policyholder interests and ensuring timely claim settlements.
Responsible for approving insurance products and regulating premium rates in specific cases.
Regulates market intermediaries, including insurance agents and brokers.
Promotes and fosters professional organizations within the insurance industry.

blocks.content: • Regulates premium rates in certain cases.

items: IRDAI regulates both insurance companies and intermediaries such as agents and brokers.
Approval of insurance products and regulation of premium rates in certain cases are direct functions of IRDAI.
Timely settlement of claims is a statutory function enforced by IRDAI to protect policyholders.

blocks.content: • Regulates intermediaries such as agents and brokers.
